author: marcfeuermann
body:
Very interesting update. Despite the large number of primary annotations (CC and BP), we never had the right term. For example, we had endoplasmic reticulum, membrane, and a bunch of other membranes, but never “endoplasmic reticulum membrane.” Also, for MF, I would suggest the term   **GO:0140388 protein translocation chaperone activity** but it is not yet available for PAINT, as it is too recent. I will close the ticket once I have finished annotating the family.
Thanks a lot,
Marc.

author: ValWood
body:
Hi MArc, where does GO:0140388 protein translocation chaperone activity  come from? I have 

guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity
not GO:0140388 protein translocation chaperone activity
Binding to the exposed unfolded portion of a polypeptide as it emerges from a membrane translocation channel/pore to drive its unidirectional transport across a membrane. Iterative cycles of ATP-dependent binding/rebinding by the chaperone prevents back sliding and drive vectorial transport.

is that a typo?

author: marcfeuermann
body:
Oups, sorry, Wrong answer in the wrong ticket,
This was for https://github.com/geneontology/go-annotation/issues/6385
That's it when one opens 20 windows at a time.

author: marcfeuermann
body:
There, that's done. This one was pretty easy to fix. Since opening families in PAINT isn't instantaneous, I always do batches of 4 or 5 so I don't waste too much time waiting. So, when the order of the tickets and families isn’t the same on my screen, I sometimes answer the wrong one. This is the first time I didn’t notice it before sending the answer.
Sorry again for this blunder.
